notes: Real townsfolk made in Blender: kids, elders, bald and bearded people, heavy and muscular builds, different heights
People have jobs that fit their town: fishers with rods on the docks, dock workers hammering, merchants, scholars reading, gardeners, sweepers, smiths
They work with natural pauses, turn to look at you when you come close, and tell you who they are when you talk to them
